# neo4jaura Provider





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `client_id` (String, Sensitive) Aura Client ID. Can also be set via the `AURA_CLIENT_ID` environment variable.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Aura Client Secret. Can also be set via the `AURA_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable.
- `instance_timeout` (Number) Timeout for instance operations (seconds). Defaults to 900 seconds
- `snapshot_timeout` (Number) Timeout for snapshot operations (seconds). Defaults to 300 seconds
